# IDEA – International Dialects of English Archive

> The world's leading comprehensive audio archive of English accents and dialects from every major global region, featuring native speaker recordings, phonetic transcriptions, and interactive learning tools.

IDEA provides linguists, actors, educators, and language enthusiasts with authentic dialect samples across Africa, Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania. The archive includes oral histories, phonetic transcriptions, and specialized resources for theatrical pronunciation and speech analysis.

## Key Topics

- English dialects
- Audio samples
- Regional accents
- Phonetic transcriptions
- Received Pronunciation
- General American
- Native American English
- Oral histories
- Pronunciation guides
- Accent identification
- Linguistic archive
- IPA transcriptions
- Theatre dialect resources
- Global English variations
- Speech samples

## Global Dialect Collections

- [North America](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/north-america): North American English dialects and accents directory with audio samples.
- [Europe](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/europe): European English dialects and accents directory with audio samples.
- [Asia](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/asia): Asian English dialects and accents directory with audio samples.
- [Africa](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/africa): African English dialects and accents directory with audio samples.
- [Australia-Oceania](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/australia-oceania): Australia-Oceania English dialects including New Zealand and Fiji.
- [Caribbean](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/caribbean): Caribbean English dialects and accents directory with audio samples.
- [Central America](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/central-america): Central American English dialects and accents directory with audio.
- [South America](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/south-america): South American English dialects and accents directory with audio.
- [Middle East](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/middle-east): Middle Eastern English dialects and accents directory with audio.

## Major Dialect Categories

- [Received Pronunciation](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/received-pronunciation): Received Pronunciation (Standard British English) recordings.
- [General American](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/general-american): General American dialect recordings and speech samples.
- [Native American Accents and Dialects](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/native-americans): Native American English dialects and accents from US and Canada.

## Linguistic Resources

- [Phonetic Transcriptions](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/phonetic-transcriptions): IPA phonetic transcriptions of dialect samples for linguistic analysis.
- [Oral Histories](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/oral-histories): Oral history recordings from native speakers across regions.

## Specialized Applications

- [Play Names and Terms](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/play-names-terms): Theatre-focused dialect and pronunciation guide for plays and musicals.
- [Test Your Ear](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/test-your-ear): Interactive dialect identification quiz to test accent recognition skills.

## Optional Resources

- [Speech and Voice Disorders](https://www.dialectsarchive.com/speech-and-voice-disorders): Speech and voice disorder samples including autism spectrum disorder.
